case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for setting out the cost shares behind your offer. The rising indices warrant consideration, but their weighted effect needs to be distinguished from the actual cost of material already covered.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +7.5%, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

The longer agreement gives you demand visibility, while our proposed prices reflect the need for a verifiable cost basis without overlapping recovery. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining the terms you requested; please choose whichever package works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.17 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.11 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.12 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our partnership and look forward to agreeing a defensible basis for continued supply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your calculations and acknowledge the delivery record data you provided. 

Our offer is a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We welcome the 24-month agreement with 30-day payment terms, but for this duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause rather than a fixed price. Please note that our AS-14404 material is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so current market decreases do not immediately reduce our costs; nevertheless, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Alternatively, we can present another package: a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for revising your price and acknowledging the delivery record.

We are making a modest price concession and are flexible on indexation, but expect a corresponding price step from you. Option B gives you the index clause you requested in exchange for a lower price; please choose whether this or the fixed-price option works better for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.29 per unit, fixed price, no index clause, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.24 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

Could we review your material and processing calculation together, including how fixed-price alloy coverage is reflected and when uncovered costs first enter deliveries?

We appreciate your practical approach to reaching a defensible agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We welcome your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which is necessary for a 24-month agreement. Because our cost basis remains unchanged, we must hold our price at €5.46 per unit for the 90-day payment term. 

Please understand that we cannot accommodate your request for a joint review of our material and processing calculations, as this information is strictly confidential. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

To recap, our offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for clarifying that your price remains unchanged and that indexation is essential to the longer agreement. We respect the confidentiality of your detailed calculations and recognise your concern about future alloy exposure, but an unchanged cost basis does not resolve our price difference.

We are making a modest price concession and remain flexible on indexation; in return, we expect a price improvement from you. The indexed option gives you the alloy clause you requested alongside longer demand visibility, while the fixed-price option offers certainty; please tell us which works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.34 per unit, fixed price, no index clause, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.29 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We value our relationship and would welcome a corresponding commercial step from you.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued flexibility and the modest price concession in your latest offer. However, as our cost basis remains unchanged, we are unable to reduce our price further and must hold our offer at €5.46 per unit for the 90-day payment term. 

Please note that for a 24-month agreement, we require the AS-14404 index clause without a deadband to ensure sustainable supply. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

To summarize our Angebot, we present a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
